subject.title: fix(line): prevent silent webhook loss after acknowledgment

question: Is the reported source-blind nine-scenario spool validation sufficient for this LINE transport migration, or must the PR show a live LINE webhook/restart/redelivery run before merge?
rationale: The implementation follows the intended shared-drain architecture, but the change controls acknowledgment, dedupe, retry, and turn completion on a user-facing channel; only maintainers can accept synthetic proof in place of the repository’s normal channel-specific live-proof expectation.

options.title: Require live LINE proof
options.body: Hold merge until a real LINE webhook demonstrates acknowledgment gating, restart recovery, redelivery dedupe, and no post-adoption replay.

options.title: Accept the harness proof
options.body: Treat the source-blind spool scenarios and focused test suite as sufficient because the transport boundary is otherwise unchanged.

recommendation.title: Require live LINE proof
recommendation.body: Hold merge until a real LINE webhook demonstrates acknowledgment gating, restart recovery, redelivery dedupe, and no post-adoption replay.

likelyOwner.reason: They documented the shared drain’s channel-adoption contract and expected crash/restart proof for this migration program.
